author: 5kO0
content:
Found while drafting a downstream design doc that depends on proto-blue.

Issue: `crates/proto-blue/src/lib.rs` lines 35-39 (the umbrella crate rustdoc) shows a feature table marking the network-dependent features as wasm-in-progress and citing tracker issue numbers:

```
| Feature    | Re-exports                             | WASM? |
| (none)     | ...wasm-clean base set...              | ✅ |
| `net`      | `xrpc`                                 | 🚧 (issue #25) |
| `ws`       | `ws`, enables `repo::Firehose`         | 🚧 (issue #27) |
| `resolver` | `identity`                             | 🚧 (issue #26) |
| `oauth`    | `oauth`                                | 🚧 |
| `api`      | `api`                                  | 🚧 |
| `full`     | everything                             | ❌ (default — native only) |
```

Stale on two counts:

1. **Wasm support is already shipped.** `crates/proto-blue/Cargo.toml` has full target-conditional dep tables (`[target.'cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")'.dependencies]`) that auto-swap to `fetch-web` / `gloo-ws` / browser-side identity/api/oauth on wasm32. Every dependent subcrate has the wasm-clean feature. The cargo doc-comment in that same Cargo.toml literally asserts "`full` builds cleanly on every target".
2. **The cited issue numbers point to unrelated, closed work** — #25 is codegen multi-line lexicon description fix, #26 is interop MST root-CID parity test, #27 is interop CAR layout byte-equivalence test. No wasm tickets exist in the tracker (`crosslink issue search wasm` returns nothing).

Suggested fix: rewrite the feature table to drop the 🚧 markers and stale issue refs, and add a one-liner noting that backend selection is automatic via the target-conditional dep table. Something like:

```
| Feature    | Re-exports                             | Native            | Wasm32           |
| (none)     | wasm-clean base set                    | ✅                 | ✅                |
| `net`      | `xrpc`                                 | reqwest + axum    | gloo-net          |
| `ws`       | `ws`, enables `repo::Firehose`         | tungstenite        | gloo-ws           |
| `resolver` | `identity`                             | DNS + reqwest     | HTTPS .well-known |
| `oauth`    | `oauth`                                | ✅                 | ✅                |
| `api`      | `api`                                  | ✅                 | ✅                |
| `full`     | everything                             | ✅ (default)       | ✅                |
```

Related observation (separate issue if wanted): proto-blue has no upstream CI of any kind under `.github/`, so the wasm build path is structurally sound but not load-bearing-tested. The downstream design doc that flagged this (`Polaris/.design/polaris-proto-blue-integration.md` AC-12) takes responsibility for being the first wasm-build verifier and surfacing failures upstream.
